title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent helps find privileged workflow injection in Harvester
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: The issue-management-link-backport-pr workflow interpolates a pull request title into a shell heredoc under pull_request_target, allowing code injection in a repository-privileged context.
ai_role: GHSL credits CodeQL and its AI agent. It reports the issue on 2025-08-04 and says it was fixed 2025-08-06; the source does not identify which contribution found the flaw first.
classification_note: The public advisory documents the vulnerability and disclosure/remediation status. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Maintainer fixed the issue 2025-08-06. No CVE was established in this advisory.

impacts.conditions: Untrusted checkout or PR input reaches privileged Harvester workflow; GHSL advisory describes workflow injection.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
